anomalies.observed: On page 1, the cathode node of D1 (PMEG3030EP) is connected to both pins 1 and 2 of the 3-pin servo headers J11 and J6, as well as to the 100 µF bulk capacitors. The only other header connection is pin 3 to the signal network. No GND connection is shown on the servo headers.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the servo headers are 3-pin headers with pin 3 as the signal pin and pin 2 fed from the servo power rail. A SG90-class or serial servo header must also provide a GND return path, normally on the remaining header pin. Pin 1 should be GND, not tied to the +5 V servo rail.

evidence.quote: D1 PMEG3030EP 3A 360mV; J11 Conn_01x03; J6 Conn_01x03 (page 1)
J3, J8 Conn_01x03 Servo header ... Pin 3 is the signal pin
D2 ... feeds a dedicated servo power rail ... before reaching J3/J8 pin 2

anomalies.impact: The servos would have no proper ground return through the header; if the intended ground pin is pin 1, it is shorted to the servo power rail. This would prevent normal servo operation and could damage the servo or board.

anomalies.observed: The two 2x15 bus connectors are not identical on pins 5 and 7: J5 shows +3V3 on pin 7 and NET0016 on pin 5, while J9 shows +3V3 on pin 5 and NET0020 on pin 7.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the top and bottom M5Stack bus connectors have identical nets on both connectors so the board can be used as a pass-through carrier, carrying +3V3 on the same pin on both connectors.

evidence.quote: J5 Conn_02x15_Odd_Even with +3V3/NET0016 labels; J9 Conn_02x15_Odd_Even with +3V3/NET0020 labels (page 1)
J1 / J2 Conn_02x15_Odd_Even ... identical nets on both so the board can be stacked between the M5Stack Core and a lower module (pass-through)

anomalies.impact: A stacked module would not receive the correct +3V3/GPIO pass-through mapping; one bus pin may be tied to 3V3 while another expected signal is missing or misrouted.

parsed.summary: The drawing shows at least two connectivity deviations: the servo headers appear to have their ground pin tied to the servo power rail instead of GND, and the two 2x15 bus connectors are not identical on the 3V3/GPIO pins, breaking the intended pass-through.
